//! Run at the published pre-repair source; never regenerate with the successor.
use std::path::Path;
use whipplescript_kernel::{
    coerce::{CoerceRequest, FakeCoerceClient},
    rule_pass::step_instance_generic,
    CoerceExecution, ProgramVersionInput, RuntimeKernel,
};
use whipplescript_parser::compile_program;
use whipplescript_store::{native_stores::NativeStores, RuntimeStore};

const SOURCE: &str = r#"use std.coercion
@service
workflow LegacyAssertions
signal item.arrived { item string }
class Decision { disposition "keep" | "flag" }
class Choice { disposition "keep" | "flag" }
class Settled { item string stage string }
coerce choose(text string) -> Choice {
  prompt """markdown
Return keep. {{ text }}
{{ ctx.output_format }}
"""
}
rule decide
  when item.arrived as item
=> {
  record Decision { disposition "keep" }
  record Settled { item item.item stage "top" }
  coerce choose(item.item) as first
  after first succeeds as result {
    record Decision { disposition "keep" }
    record Settled { item item.item stage "after" }
    coerce choose(item.item) as second
    after second succeeds as result {
      record Decision { disposition "keep" }
      record Settled { item item.item stage "nested" }
    }
  }
}
"#;

fn save(path: &Path, value: &[u8]) {
    use std::io::Write;
    std::fs::OpenOptions::new().write(true).create_new(true).open(path)
        .expect("new fixture output").write_all(value).expect("write fixture");
}

fn main() {
    let root = std::path::PathBuf::from(std::env::args_os().nth(1).expect("new output directory"));
    std::fs::create_dir(&root).expect("new fixture directory");
    let compiled = compile_program(SOURCE);
    let ir = compiled.ir.unwrap_or_else(|| panic!("{:?}", compiled.diagnostics));
    let mut kernel = RuntimeKernel::new(NativeStores::open(
        root.join("runtime.sqlite"), root.join("coord.sqlite"), root.join("items.sqlite"),
    ).expect("native stores"));
    kernel.store_mut().register_package_manifest(include_str!("../../../std/manifests/coercion.json"))
        .expect("coercion manifest");
    let source_hash = kernel.store_mut().put_content(SOURCE).expect("retain source");
    let snapshot = ir.to_snapshot();
    let ir_hash = kernel.store_mut().put_content(&snapshot).expect("retain IR");
    let version = kernel.create_program_version_for_program(ProgramVersionInput {
        program_name: &ir.workflow, source_hash: &source_hash,
        ir_hash: &ir_hash, compiler_version: "legacy-fixture",
        ir_snapshot: Some(&snapshot),
    }, &ir).expect("version");
    let instance = kernel.create_instance(&version, "{}").expect("instance");
    kernel.ingest_external_event(&instance, "external.started", "{}", Some("start")).expect("start");
    kernel.derive_fact(&instance, "item.arrived", "first", r#"{"item":"first"}"#, None, Some("first"))
        .expect("old firing");
    let mut executed = 0;
    for _ in 0..6 {
        step_instance_generic(&mut kernel, &instance, &ir, None, None).expect("step");
        let effects = kernel.claimable_effects(&instance).expect("claimable effects");
        if effects.is_empty() { break; }
        for effect in effects {
            let request = CoerceRequest::with_evidence_hashes(
                "choose".into(), "{\"text\":\"fixture\"}".into(), "Choice".into(),
            );
            kernel.run_coerce(CoerceExecution {
                instance_id: &instance, effect_id: &effect.effect_id,
                run_id: &format!("run:{}", effect.effect_id), provider: "fixture", worker_id: "test",
                lease_id: &format!("lease:{}", effect.effect_id),
                lease_expires_at: "2030-01-01T00:00:00Z", request: &request, model: None,
            }, &FakeCoerceClient::succeeds(r#"{"disposition":"keep"}"#)).expect("complete effect");
            executed += 1;
        }
    }
    assert_eq!(executed, 2, "complete both old continuation effects");
    assert_eq!(step_instance_generic(&mut kernel, &instance, &ir, None, None).expect("stable replay").committed_rules, 0);
    let events = kernel.store().list_events(&instance).expect("old events");
    assert!(!events.iter().any(|event| event.event_type == "instance.created"));
    save(&root.join("source.whip"), SOURCE.as_bytes());
    let event_views = events.iter().map(|event| serde_json::json!({
        "event_id": event.event_id, "sequence": event.sequence,
        "event_type": event.event_type, "payload_json": event.payload_json,
        "source": event.source, "occurred_at": event.occurred_at,
    })).collect::<Vec<_>>();
    save(&root.join("events.json"), &serde_json::to_vec_pretty(&event_views).expect("serialize events"));
    save(&root.join("provenance.json"), &serde_json::to_vec_pretty(&serde_json::json!({
        "source_revision": "44302912257d49dbf033fe2543400c640f6fa71b",
        "instance_id": instance, "version_id": version.version_id,
        "completed_effects": executed,
    })).expect("serialize provenance"));
    drop(kernel);
    println!("Old assertion fixture written to {}", root.display());
}
